name: WhisperGate
desc: A Russian state-sponsored malware campaign targeting Ukraine.

acts.d: Attackers gained initial access through stolen credentials and likely had access to the victim's network for months
The malware is written to the C: drive in various directories and executes via Impacket
Executable wipes the MBR and replaces it with the ransom note
The malware executes a base64-encoded PowerShell command twice to make the machine sleep for 20 seconds
The malware retrieves a file from a Discord channel.
JPG file is loaded as a .NET assembly file; when restored, it is a Win32 DLL
WhisperGate uses Eazfuscator to obfuscate the .NET malware
The DLL drops a VBScript into the %Temp% directory and executes it.
The script modifies Windows Defender settings to exclude the C: from being scanned
A resource from the DLL is loaded into memory and decoded by a XOR operation
Decoded resource is another .NET DLL containing 2 additional resources
AdvancedRun uses PowerShell to execute multiple commands to stop Windows Defender from running and to delete its files and directories from memory
Waqybg resource is loaded into memory and restores it as the wiper payload. The DLL then injects the payload into legitimate Windows utility InstallUtil.exe
The malware executes Waqybg through the legitimate program InstallUtil
The wiper looks for fixed logical drives in the system
The wiper looks for remote logical drives in the system
For each enumeration, the malware wipes the files in the logical drive with specific file extensions, while ignoring files in the %HOMEDRIVE%/Windows directory.
WhisperGate deletes InstallerUtil.exe" from the %TEMP% directory.
WhisperGate attempts to stop all running processes (including itself) by calling ExitWindowsEx API
